From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@blueforge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal request — restructure of private offer term & seat split

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from procurement at BlueForge. We're preparing the renewal for our private offer (current PO ends Aug 31, 2027) and want to propose two changes to reduce our operational friction and align spend across groups: 

1) Move the private offer term from 12 months to 18 months (effective 9/1) in exchange for a 10% blended discount on the committed unit price.
2) Reallocate seats: 60% US region / 40% EU region (billing remains under BlueForge HQ) and split acceptance into two tranches so our EU legal can sign on a slightly delayed timeline.

We can provide a new PO if you can confirm pricing math and whether Redwood can split invoice tranches (we'd like two invoices: 9/1 for US tranche, 11/1 for EU tranche). Please also flag any marketplace acceptance caveats for an 18-month term.

Attaching our draft PO (PDF stub). Happy to jump on a quick call this week — Jordan Park, Procurement.

--
Jordan Park
Head of Procurement | BlueForge
procurement@blueforge.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@blueforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request — restructure of private offer term & seat split

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the PO stub. This is doable; outline below is what I propose as a mutual action plan so we can get this into the marketplace/private offer flow without blocking your EU sign-off.

Proposal summary:
- Term: 18 months starting 2027-09-01.
- Commercial: 10% blended on committed unit price for the full 18 months (applies to both tranches).
- Seat allocation: 60% US / 40% EU. We will create an amendment that enumerates the region split and acceptance windows.
- Invoicing: We can issue two invoices (US tranche on 2027-09-01; EU tranche on 2027-11-01) but marketplace acceptance requires a single private-offer amendment to be accepted in the marketplace console — backend acceptance will mark both tranches as part of the same offer.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Final PO with billing contact and PO number (please attach).
2) Confirm EU signing ETA (approx week of 10/25 is fine).

Internal actions on our side: sales will route amendment to Public Cloud Marketplace team for a private-offer amendment, Legal will prepare a short amendment doc, and Finance will validate invoicing cadence. If you want, I can create a DocuSign envelope for the amendment once Legal uploads it.

Proposed timeline: 48-72 hours to draft amendment after we receive the final PO + billing contact; marketplace acceptance typically 5-7 business days after DocuSign return (subject to marketplace queue).

If that matches your expectations, I’ll kick off the internal approvals. Want to call at 2pm PT today to align?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Action items (can we triage today):
- Marissa: confirm commercial approval for 10% blended concession on the 18mo term (this is below list price but within ARR ramp expectations if we net-back the committed spend).
- Ben: confirm marketplace ops can accept a single private-offer amendment that enumerates tranches and invoicing dates (they flagged similar before; want to avoid rework).
- Kimberly: confirm Finance is ok with two invoice dates across the same private offer and whether we need any special accounting tag for EU tax handling.
- Tessa: quick legal read on a short amendment (we want minimum friction: term + seat split + invoicing cadence).

Why this matters: BlueForge is expanding usage and is a good reference; keeping invoice cadence aligned to their internal fiscal quarters helps them convert more committed seats now. If we can move quickly this week, we should lock the renewal before end of May.

I’ve drafted a skeleton amendment (attached) that legal can iterate on. If you can reply with approvals or concerns by EOD, I’ll relay to Jordan and send a DocuSign link.

Thanks — Aditya
